field_notes.filename: Original filename from the site, unchanged (including the site's own typos).
field_notes.caption: Figure caption from the page (figcaption, identical to the link's data-caption).
field_notes.scale: All images are 2x (Retina): every file carries 144 dpi metadata and the full-screen captures are 3360x2100 px = 1680x1050 pt. width_pt/height_pt are pixels / 2.
field_notes.appearance: System appearance (light or dark). Determined by viewing every image; where appearance_visually_distinct is false the image itself does not reveal the appearance and the value comes from the page section.
field_notes.capture: full-screen = whole 3360x2100 display; window = single window/dialog with transparent background and drop shadow; region = opaque rectangular crop of part of the screen.
field_notes.counterpart: Filename of the same surface in the other appearance (the light and dark sections contain the same 131 captions; matched by caption). null for the accent-combination shots.
field_notes.surface_type: desktop, dock, window, preferences-window, preferences-pane, dialog, alert, sheet, panel, menu, overlay, notification or full-screen.
